title: The image route on ImajevBench v2.0-lite's 254 labelled items, beside the text engine on one card, internal
hardware: 1x NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q Workstation Edition (96 GB)

software.patch_series_flag_note: the flag was named VLLM_R9_SUFFIX_STAGING when this run was made; its logs keep that name

model.text_engine: the text-only view, 0.47 of the card
model.image_engine: the official checkpoint under Qwen3_5MoeForConditionalGeneration (vision tower in bf16), 0.49 of the card
model.temperature: not applied on the image route

serving.pad: front, to the 1,056-token block (images and state in the cached prefix)
serving.rendering: keys as sent (no index-key hiding or de-snaking); exact ties were not resolved by key order, and the harness rejected 2 items whose answers tied exactly (counted wrong)

arms.image_abstain: --abstain-option "can't tell" (untrained, reported as imajev's unknown_probability / abstained)

harnesses.imajev: github.com/mohit67890/imajev @ d2adbb8 (Apache-2.0), its own harness and scorer against /v1/systemone
harnesses.imajevbench: github.com/mohit67890/imajev-bench @ 043ab1f, v2.0-lite, the 254 labelled dev and calibration items (CC BY 4.0; images CC0, AI-generated); 230 answerable, 24 with reference Unknown

gates.paired text check: 200 of 200 suite items bit-identical through the text route and the image engine (p1.json)
gates.text route beside the image engine: 0.99 to 1.08 times its latency alone in all six cells (cost_gates.json)

results.image_over_text_latency: 1.24 to 1.84 times a text request of equal state tokens, 2.12 times in one of six cells (a 1536x1024 photo with one question)

files.imajev/<arm>/<split>/: the harness's predictions.jsonl (per item: id, our distribution, latency), score.json, manifest.json, completion.json
files.accuracy.json: accuracy per arm and subset with 95% intervals
files.cost_*.json: latency per cell, alone and co-resident, and the memory split
files.p1.json: the paired text check per item (task and index of the private suite, no text)

excluded: the harness's raw.jsonl (requests with the items' text)
vLLM start-up logs, machine logs and addresses
